title: Grand Theft Auto V (Legacy)
provenance: played here on the Steam copy, M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-crossover26.3-r5, 2026-09-09. Also reported 5 of 5 by vancevcs (highball-db#202, 2026-09-24), Apple M1, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.32, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, DXMT, after 36 minutes, with the Metal HUD on. Checked 2026-10-03 on an M4, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.4 build, engine x64-crossover26.3-r16, DXMT: reached the display calibration screen with -nobattleye, not played.
notes:
Story mode plays. Needs engine x64-crossover26.3-r5 or later and the DXMT renderer. Launch it from Steam: Steam starts the Rockstar Games Launcher, which signs in and hands off to the game. The row passes -nobattleye on the Steam command line, the story-mode path: without it a fresh launcher profile starts GTA5_BE.exe and BattlEye's installer asks for its kernel driver, which cannot run under Wine (seen on an M4, 2026-10-03). Checked again 2026-10-03 on an M4, macOS 27.0, engine x64-crossover26.3-r16 (the Wine 11 engine with the fixed DXMT), DXMT: the launcher signed in through the Steam entitlement and the game reached its display calibration screen five minutes after Play, nothing played past it that run.

Both of the things that used to stop this game are fixed. The launcher's sign-in window is a Chromium surface whose GPU process draws into another process's window, which rendered nothing until engine patch 0007 (cross-process child swapchains) plus DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1, both of which the rockstar recipe applies. And the sign-in itself was refused for reasons that looked like a network or account problem but were the Mac's clock: with the time zone set automatically, it signs in.

GTA Online cannot work. BattlEye ships with the game (a BattlEye directory and GTA5_BE.exe) and is kernel-level anti-cheat, so online is out under Wine on any tool. Story mode is the whole claim here.

Community reports of about 120 fps on an M1 Pro were measured on CrossOver's own tree, often with frame generation on. Our range overlaps at the top but the low end is 60, and the open world has not been measured at all, so treat the community figure as an upper bound rather than an expectation.

A player report on 2026-09-24 rates it perfect after 36 minutes on an M1 with macOS 27.0, on the Wine 10 engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5 rather than the Wine 11 one this entry says the launcher needs. That has not been checked here. One possible reason is a launcher that was already signed in, since the Wine 10 engine's problem was drawing the sign-in window, but that is a guess. Re-checked on 2026-10-05 on an M4 with the Wine 11 engine r15 and -nobattleye: launcher passed, the game opens on its first-run display calibration screen.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

requiresLauncher.name: Rockstar Games Launcher
requiresLauncher.note: Required. Steam starts it and it hands off to the game after sign-in. It installs and signs in on the Wine 11 engine (x64-crossover26.3-r15 or later) through the rockstar recipe, which Play applies and which offers that engine. The Wine 10 engine cannot draw its sign-in window, which is why the recipe moves the environment. The launcher last passed on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-10-05.

verified.fps: first-run display calibration reached, not played this run
verified.how: Steam copy through Highball on an M4 on 2026-10-05, DXMT, the Wine 11 engine r15, -nobattleye: launcher passed, the game opens on its first-run Display Calibration screen at 200 s.

knownIssues.symptom: The Rockstar launcher shows a blank or black sign-in window and the game never starts.
knownIssues.cause: the sign-in is a Chromium surface drawn by a separate GPU process into the browser process's window. Wine returned nothing for it until engine patch 0007.
knownIssues.fix: use engine x64-crossover26.3-r5 or later with the DXMT renderer (the recipe asks for r15, where the launcher installer works too), and apply the rockstar recipe, which sets DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1.

knownIssues.symptom: Sign in fails with 'Sorry, we are unable to handle your request at this time' (error 1.000.7).
knownIssues.cause: the Mac's clock being wrong, not the network or the account. Rockstar rejects the request.
knownIssues.fix: System Settings, General, Date & Time, with the time zone set automatically using your location.

knownIssues.symptom: The BattlEye Launcher window asks to install BattlEye (Install / Cancel) and the game never starts (seen on an M4, Wine 11 engine r16, 2026-10-03)
knownIssues.cause: a fresh Rockstar launcher profile starts the game through GTA5_BE.exe, BattlEye's wrapper, and BattlEye's kernel driver cannot run under Wine
knownIssues.fix: start the game with -nobattleye, which Highball's Play passes for this game (from the next version after 0.10.4). By hand, put -nobattleye in Steam's launch options for the game, or turn BattlEye off for GTA V in the Rockstar launcher's settings. Story mode only either way

knownIssues.cause: BattlEye, a kernel-level anti-cheat, which cannot run under Wine.

knownIssues.symptom: A DualSense controller does not bind in the game while it works in other games in the same environment (reported on an M1, highball-db#72)
knownIssues.cause: the game reads controllers through XInput and DirectInput, and Wine's HID layer does not offer the DualSense to it (the log shows Wine's HID device-matching errors)
knownIssues.fix: start the game from Steam with Steam Input on for it. The reporter's DualSense works that way, in the default environment, with the game added to Steam as a non-Steam game and -nobattleye in its launch options (highball-db#72, 2026-10-07)

knownIssues.symptom: The game stays at 800x600 on a 4K monitor, and -fullscreen stretches 800x600 to the screen (reported on an M1 with the game started from Steam, highball-db#72, 2026-10-07)
knownIssues.cause: not known yet. It ran on DXMT, which is what this page recommends and what a game started from inside Steam gets in an environment set to D3DMetal, since Steam's own window starts with DXMT there
